description: This file is a Java source file that implements the BankingService interface. It provides methods for managing customers, accounts, transactions, and transfers in a banking application. It uses Spring Framework annotations and repositories to interact with the database.

classes.name: BankingServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the BankingService interface providing core banking operations such as customer management, account creation, fund transfer, and transaction retrieval.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customers in the system and converts each to a CustomerDetails domain object.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record in the database from the provided CustomerDetails object.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Finds a customer by their customer number and returns the corresponding CustomerDetails object.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates an existing customer's details based on the provided CustomerDetails object and customer number.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer record identified by the customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds an account using its account number and returns the account information.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account for a specified customer based on provided account information.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Transfers funds from one account to another for a specific customer, performing necessary validations.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Fetches all transactions for a specific account.
